/// The shared row guard accepts at most this many (row, expert) pairs.
#[cfg_attr(
    not(all(feature = "native-cuda", target_os = "linux")),
    allow(dead_code)
)]
pub(crate) const MAX_STREAM_PAIRS: usize = 65_536;

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{STREAM_ROWS, wants_device_stream};

    #[test]
    fn device_stream_needs_the_opt_in_and_more_than_eight_rows() {
        // The default (unset / "cpu") is the CPU pool at every size.
        assert!(!wants_device_stream(STREAM_ROWS + 1, STREAM_ROWS + 1, None));
        assert!(!wants_device_stream(
            STREAM_ROWS + 1,
            STREAM_ROWS + 1,
            Some("cpu")
        ));
        assert!(!wants_device_stream(
            STREAM_ROWS + 1,
            STREAM_ROWS + 1,
            Some("")
        ));
        // "gpu" streams only above the Basalt threshold.
        assert!(!wants_device_stream(STREAM_ROWS, STREAM_ROWS, Some("gpu")));
        assert!(wants_device_stream(
            STREAM_ROWS + 1,
            STREAM_ROWS + 1,
            Some("gpu")
        ));
        // Anything else is not an opt-in; unknown values never stream.
        assert!(!wants_device_stream(4096, 4096, Some("GPU")));
        assert!(!wants_device_stream(4096, 4096, Some("yes")));
    }

    #[test]
    fn device_stream_falls_back_outside_the_pair_grid() {
        assert!(!wants_device_stream(4096, 4096 * 22, Some("gpu")));
        assert!(wants_device_stream(2978, 2978 * 22, Some("gpu")));
        assert!(wants_device_stream(65_536, 65_536, Some("gpu")));
        assert!(!wants_device_stream(65_536, 65_537, Some("gpu")));
        assert!(!wants_device_stream(9, 8, Some("gpu")));
        assert!(!wants_device_stream(9, 0, Some("gpu")));
        assert!(!wants_device_stream(usize::MAX, usize::MAX, Some("gpu")));
    }
}
//! The shared expert tier: routed experts split between VRAM, the host CPU and the page cache,
//! each expert in exactly one place, for any large mixture-of-experts model.
//!
//! WHAT lives here, with no model family named anywhere:
//! - [`Residency`]: which experts of which layer are device-resident (one assignment per expert) and how a
//!   layer's picks split ([`Coverage`]). Whole-layer placement fills it today; a popularity-chosen
//!   hot set can fill it later without touching the decode path.
//! - [`place_gpu_layers`]: uploads the chosen experts once, fits the count to the free VRAM, and
//!   drops the host page cache of what it uploaded so no expert counts twice.
//! - [`CpuTier`]: the CPU worker pool plus the zero-copy read-only mapped views of the experts
//!   that stay on the host, behind a format-specific [`CpuExpertKernel`].
//! - [`run_overlapped`]: the hand-off that runs the CPU experts on a scoped thread while the
//!   caller keeps the device busy with the shared expert.
//! - [`TokenSplit`] and [`TierReport`]: where each decoded token spent its time.
//!
//! WHAT a model family supplies, the whole narrow interface:
//! 1. expert id to weight views: [`ExpertPayloadSource`] reads one expert's bytes for the device
//!    upload, and the family maps the host-served layers read-only ([`map_read_only`]) into
//!    whatever view type its CPU kernel takes;
//! 2. a format-specific CPU kernel: [`CpuExpertKernel`] (Nemotron: NVFP4 on AVX-512/AVX2);
//! 3. a GPU expert kernel: [`GpuExpertStore`] uploads an expert part and reports free VRAM; the
//!    family's decode step calls its own device kernel on resident keys.
//!
//! The CPU pool and mapping follow the patterns of `family::qwen36::tiered` (`cpu_pool`,
//! `mapped_file`, `host`), whose [`MappedFile`](crate::family::qwen36::tiered::mapped_file) this
//! reuses unchanged; extracting that module onto this interface is the next step.

mod cpu;
pub(crate) mod gpu_stream;
mod overlap;
mod plan;
mod report;
mod residency;
mod stream;
#[cfg(all(feature = "native-cuda", target_os = "linux"))]
mod stream_cuda;
#[cfg(all(test, feature = "native-cuda", target_os = "linux"))]
pub(crate) mod stream_cuda_profile;
#[cfg(all(feature = "native-cuda", target_os = "linux"))]
mod stream_nvfp4;

pub use cpu::{CpuExpertKernel, CpuTier, ExpertPick, map_read_only};
pub use overlap::{Overlap, run_overlapped};
pub use plan::{
    ExpertPayload, ExpertPayloadSource, ExpertPayloadView, GpuExpertStore, GpuLayerPlan,
    VRAM_HEADROOM_BYTES, auto_fit_gpu_layers, place_gpu_layers,
};
pub use report::{TierReport, TokenSplit};
pub use residency::{Coverage, Placement, Residency};
pub use stream::StreamBankPlan;
#[cfg(all(feature = "native-cuda", target_os = "linux"))]
pub(crate) use stream_cuda::CudaStreamBanks;
#[cfg(all(feature = "native-cuda", target_os = "linux"))]
pub(crate) use stream_nvfp4::launch_device_input as project_nvfp4_batch_device;
#[cfg(all(feature = "native-cuda", target_os = "linux"))]
pub(crate) use stream_nvfp4::launch_host_input as project_nvfp4_batch_launch;
#[cfg(all(feature = "native-cuda", target_os = "linux"))]
pub(crate) use stream_nvfp4::project as project_nvfp4_batch;
#[cfg(all(feature = "native-cuda", target_os = "linux"))]
pub(crate) use stream_nvfp4::read_f32_rows as project_nvfp4_read;

/// One routed expert of one MoE layer.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
pub struct ExpertId {
    pub layer: u32,
    pub expert: u32,
}
//! The CPU/GPU hand-off of one MoE block.

use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use crate::EngError;

/// Wall time of the two concurrent halves of one block's expert work.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Overlap {
    /// The host-expert closure, measured on its own thread.
    pub routed: Duration,
    /// The device-side closure, measured on the calling thread.
    pub shared: Duration,
    /// How long the caller then waited for the host closure after the device side finished.
    pub exposed: Duration,
}

/// Runs `host` on a scoped thread while the calling thread runs `device`, then joins.
///
/// The device context is thread-confined, so `device` stays on the caller and only the host
/// kernel moves. A panic in `host` comes back as an error, never as unwinding through the caller.
pub fn run_overlapped<H, D>(
    host: impl FnOnce() -> H + Send,
    device: impl FnOnce() -> D,
) -> Result<(H, D, Overlap), EngError>
where
    H: Send,
{
    let mut timing = Overlap::default();
    let (joined, device_value) = std::thread::scope(|scope| {
        let handle = scope.spawn(|| {
            let started = Instant::now();
            let value = host();
            (value, started.elapsed())
        });
        let started = Instant::now();
        let device_value = device();
        timing.shared = started.elapsed();
        let waited = Instant::now();
        let joined = handle.join();
        timing.exposed = waited.elapsed();
        (joined, device_value)
    });
    let (host_value, routed) = joined.map_err(|_| EngError::Backend {
        operation: "expert_tier_overlap",
        message: "the host-expert thread panicked".to_owned(),
    })?;
    timing.routed = routed;
    Ok((host_value, device_value, timing))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn both_halves_run_and_the_device_side_hides_the_host_side() {
        let (host, device, timing) = run_overlapped(
            || {
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(60));
                7
            },
            || {
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(80));
                "device"
            },
        )
        .expect("overlap");
        assert_eq!((host, device), (7, "device"));
        assert!(timing.routed >= Duration::from_millis(60));
        assert!(timing.shared >= Duration::from_millis(80));
        // The host side finished first, so almost none of it is exposed.
        assert!(timing.exposed < Duration::from_millis(30), "{timing:?}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_slower_host_side_is_exposed_by_the_difference() {
        let (_, _, timing) = run_overlapped(
            || std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(120)),
            || std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20)),
        )
        .expect("overlap");
        assert!(timing.exposed >= Duration::from_millis(60), "{timing:?}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_panicking_host_side_is_an_error_not_an_unwind() {
        let outcome = run_overlapped(|| -> u32 { panic!("kernel bug") }, || 1);
        assert!(matches!(outcome, Err(EngError::Backend { .. })));
    }
}
//! Placement: which MoE layers keep their routed experts on the device, fitted to the free VRAM.

use super::{ExpertId, residency::Residency};
use crate::EngError;

/// VRAM the tier leaves free after its resident experts and the family's dense weight cache.
pub const VRAM_HEADROOM_BYTES: u64 = 3 << 30;

/// How many MoE layers keep their routed experts on the GPU.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum GpuLayerPlan {
    /// As many as the free VRAM allows after the dense cache, leaving [`VRAM_HEADROOM_BYTES`].
    Auto,
    /// Exactly this many (zero means every MoE layer runs on the CPU).
    Fixed(usize),
}

/// How many whole MoE layers fit: `free` VRAM minus what the dense weight cache will still take
/// and the headroom, divided by one layer's measured footprint, capped at `max_layers`.
pub fn auto_fit_gpu_layers(
    free_bytes: u64,
    reserved_bytes: u64,
    layer_bytes: u64,
    max_layers: usize,
) -> usize {
    let spare = free_bytes
        .saturating_sub(reserved_bytes)
        .saturating_sub(VRAM_HEADROOM_BYTES);
    if layer_bytes == 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    usize::try_from(spare / layer_bytes).map_or(max_layers, |fit| fit.min(max_layers))
}

/// One part of one routed expert as the checkpoint stores it: its quantized data, the group
/// scales that go with it (empty for formats without them) and one per-tensor scale.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct ExpertPayload {
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
    pub scales: Vec<u8>,
    pub tensor_scale: f32,
    /// `[rows, columns]` of the matrix.
    pub shape: [u32; 2],
}

/// A read-only expert part borrowed from a payload or an immutable mapping.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct ExpertPayloadView<'a> {
    pub data: &'a [u8],
    pub scales: &'a [u8],
    pub tensor_scale: f32,
    pub shape: [u32; 2],
}

impl ExpertPayload {
    pub fn as_view(&self) -> ExpertPayloadView<'_> {
        ExpertPayloadView {
            data: &self.data,
            scales: &self.scales,
            tensor_scale: self.tensor_scale,
            shape: self.shape,
        }
    }
}

/// Expert id to weight bytes, the family's side of the device upload.
pub trait ExpertPayloadSource {
    /// Parts per expert (two for up and down, three for gate, up and down).
    fn parts(&self) -> usize;

    fn payload(&mut self, id: ExpertId, part: usize) -> Result<ExpertPayload, EngError>;

    /// Called once a layer's experts are on the device: the family drops the host page cache of
    /// their bytes so the expert is in exactly one place.
    fn release_layer(&mut self, layer: u32) -> Result<(), EngError>;

    /// The slices remain valid for the callback only. Mapped sources can override
    /// this owned-payload default to avoid copying the checkpoint bytes.
    fn with_payload<R>(
        &mut self,
        id: ExpertId,
        part: usize,
        consume: impl FnOnce(ExpertPayloadView<'_>) -> Result<R, EngError>,
    ) -> Result<R, EngError>
    where
        Self: Sized,
    {
        let payload = self.payload(id, part)?;
        consume(payload.as_view())
    }

    /// An optional hint; it must not change demand order or expert placement.
    fn prefetch_experts(&mut self, _ids: &[ExpertId]) -> Result<(), EngError> {
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Release only these experts' cached pages, never their whole mixed layer.
    /// The default refuses rather than evicting unrelated CPU-resident experts.
    fn release_experts(&mut self, ids: &[ExpertId]) -> Result<(), EngError> {
        if ids.is_empty() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        Err(EngError::BadRequest(
            "expert-granular release is unsupported by this source".into(),
        ))
    }
}

/// The family's device-side store of resident experts.
pub trait GpuExpertStore {
    /// Keeps one expert part on the device for the whole run, with no host copy.
    fn upload(
        &mut self,
        id: ExpertId,
        part: usize,
        payload: &ExpertPayload,
    ) -> Result<(), EngError>;

    /// Free device memory as the driver reports it.
    fn free_bytes(&self) -> Result<u64, EngError>;

    /// Device bytes the family still needs for its dense weight cache and staging; resident
    /// experts must leave them free. [`crate::expert_tier::StreamBankPlan::reserve`]
    /// includes pending streaming banks here until their allocation consumes the reservation.
    fn reserved_bytes(&self) -> u64;

    /// The placement is final: close the per-token upload paths and hold the dense cache to the
    /// `free_bytes` that are left.
    fn finish_placement(&mut self, free_bytes: u64) -> Result<(), EngError>;
}

/// Uploads whole MoE layers once, last layer first (as llama.cpp's `--n-cpu-moe` keeps its GPU
/// layers), and returns which experts are now resident. `nominal_layer_bytes` is the stored size of
/// one layer's experts; later layers are budgeted from what the first one really cost, allocation
/// rounding included. The policy is whole-layer, the result is expert-granular.
pub fn place_gpu_layers<G: GpuExpertStore, S: ExpertPayloadSource>(
    plan: GpuLayerPlan,
    moe_layers: &[u32],
    experts_per_layer: u32,
    nominal_layer_bytes: u64,
    gpu: &mut G,
    source: &mut S,
) -> Result<Residency, EngError> {
    let wanted = match plan {
        GpuLayerPlan::Fixed(count) if count > moe_layers.len() => {
            return Err(EngError::BadRequest(format!(
                "{count} GPU-resident MoE layers requested, the model has {}",
                moe_layers.len()
            )));
        }
        GpuLayerPlan::Fixed(count) => count,
        GpuLayerPlan::Auto => moe_layers.len(),
    };
    let mut residency = Residency::default();
    let mut layer_bytes = nominal_layer_bytes;
    for &layer in moe_layers.iter().rev().take(wanted) {
        let before = gpu.free_bytes()?;
        if auto_fit_gpu_layers(before, gpu.reserved_bytes(), layer_bytes, 1) == 0 {
            match plan {
                GpuLayerPlan::Auto => break,
                GpuLayerPlan::Fixed(_) => {
                    return Err(EngError::MemoryPlan(format!(
                        "{wanted} GPU-resident MoE layers do not fit: {before} bytes free, {} \
                         reserved for the dense cache and staging, {VRAM_HEADROOM_BYTES} headroom, \
                         {layer_bytes} per layer",
                        gpu.reserved_bytes()
                    )));
                }
            }
        }
        for expert in 0..experts_per_layer {
            let id = ExpertId { layer, expert };
            for part in 0..source.parts() {
                let payload = source.payload(id, part)?;
                gpu.upload(id, part, &payload)?;
            }
            residency.mark_expert(layer, expert, experts_per_layer);
        }
        source.release_layer(layer)?;
        layer_bytes = before.saturating_sub(gpu.free_bytes()?).max(layer_bytes);
    }
    let free = gpu.free_bytes()?;
    gpu.finish_placement(free)?;
    Ok(residency)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::expert_tier::{Coverage, StreamBankPlan};

    const GIB: u64 = 1 << 30;
    const EXPERTS: u32 = 4;
    const PAYLOAD: u64 = 100;
    /// 4 experts x 2 parts x 100 bytes.
    const LAYER: u64 = 800;

    struct Gpu {
        free: u64,
        reserved: u64,
        uploads: Vec<(ExpertId, usize)>,
        finished: Option<u64>,
    }

    impl GpuExpertStore for Gpu {
        fn upload(&mut self, id: ExpertId, part: usize, p: &ExpertPayload) -> Result<(), EngError> {
            self.free = self.free.saturating_sub(p.data.len() as u64);
            self.uploads.push((id, part));
            Ok(())
        }

        fn free_bytes(&self) -> Result<u64, EngError> {
            Ok(self.free)
        }

        fn reserved_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
            self.reserved
        }

        fn finish_placement(&mut self, free_bytes: u64) -> Result<(), EngError> {
            self.finished = Some(free_bytes);
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    #[derive(Default)]
    struct Source {
        released: Vec<u32>,
        fail_layer: Option<u32>,
    }

    impl ExpertPayloadSource for Source {
        fn parts(&self) -> usize {
            2
        }

        fn payload(&mut self, id: ExpertId, _part: usize) -> Result<ExpertPayload, EngError> {
            if self.fail_layer == Some(id.layer) {
                return Err(EngError::Checkpoint("unreadable".to_owned()));
            }
            Ok(ExpertPayload {
                data: vec![0; PAYLOAD as usize],
                scales: Vec::new(),
                tensor_scale: 1.0,
                shape: [1, 1],
            })
        }

        fn release_layer(&mut self, layer: u32) -> Result<(), EngError> {
            self.released.push(layer);
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    fn gpu(free: u64, reserved: u64) -> Gpu {
        Gpu {
            free,
            reserved,
            uploads: Vec::new(),
            finished: None,
        }
    }

    const MOE: [u32; 5] = [1, 3, 5, 8, 10];

    #[test]
    fn stream_bank_reservation_reaches_placement_and_the_final_cache_budget() {
        let plan = StreamBankPlan::new(LAYER, 64, 16).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(plan.bank_bytes(), LAYER);
        assert_eq!(plan.device_bytes(), 2 * LAYER + 64);
        assert_eq!(plan.host_bytes(), 2 * LAYER + 16);
        let mut device = gpu(VRAM_HEADROOM_BYTES + 5 * LAYER, 0);
        let mut reserved = plan.reserve(&mut device, 4096).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(reserved.reserved_bytes(), plan.device_bytes());
        let residency = place_gpu_layers(
            GpuLayerPlan::Auto,
            &MOE,
            EXPERTS,
            LAYER,
            &mut reserved,
            &mut Source::default(),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(residency.full_layers(), vec![8, 10]);
        drop(reserved);
        assert_eq!(device.finished, Some(device.free - plan.device_bytes()));
    }

    #[test]
    fn stream_bank_admission_refuses_overflow_and_short_budgets_before_upload() {
        assert!(matches!(
            StreamBankPlan::new(0, 0, 0),
            Err(EngError::BadRequest(_))
        ));
        for (bank, device_aux, scratch) in [(u64::MAX, 0, 0), (1, u64::MAX, 0), (1, 0, u64::MAX)] {
            assert!(matches!(
                StreamBankPlan::new(bank, device_aux, scratch),
                Err(EngError::MemoryPlan(_))
            ));
        }
        let plan = StreamBankPlan::new(LAYER, 64, 16).unwrap();
        for (free, reserved_bytes, host_budget) in [
            (
                VRAM_HEADROOM_BYTES + plan.device_bytes(),
                1,
                plan.host_bytes(),
            ),
            (
                VRAM_HEADROOM_BYTES + plan.device_bytes(),
                0,
                plan.host_bytes() - 1,
            ),
        ] {
            let mut device = gpu(free, reserved_bytes);
            assert!(matches!(
                plan.reserve(&mut device, host_budget),
                Err(EngError::MemoryPlan(_))
            ));
            assert!(device.uploads.is_empty());
            assert!(device.finished.is_none());
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn stream_bank_reservation_rechecks_actual_free_bytes_before_finishing() {
        let plan = StreamBankPlan::new(100, 40, 0).unwrap();
        let mut device = gpu(VRAM_HEADROOM_BYTES + plan.device_bytes() + 100, 0);
        let mut reserved = plan.reserve(&mut device, plan.host_bytes()).unwrap();
        reserved
            .upload(
                ExpertId {
                    layer: 7,
                    expert: 1,
                },
                0,
                &ExpertPayload {
                    data: vec![0; 200],
                    scales: Vec::new(),
                    tensor_scale: 1.0,
                    shape: [1, 1],
                },
            )
            .unwrap();
        let free = reserved.free_bytes().unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(
            reserved.finish_placement(free),
            Err(EngError::MemoryPlan(_))
        ));
        drop(reserved);
        assert!(device.finished.is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn legacy_sources_support_views_without_coarse_expert_release() {
        let mut source = Source::default();
        let id = ExpertId {
            layer: 7,
            expert: 1,
        };
        let viewed = source
            .with_payload(id, 0, |view| {
                Ok((
                    view.data.len(),
                    view.scales.len(),
                    view.tensor_scale,
                    view.shape,
                ))
            })
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(viewed, (PAYLOAD as usize, 0, 1.0, [1, 1]));
        source.prefetch_experts(&[id]).unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(
            source.release_experts(&[id]),
            Err(EngError::BadRequest(_))
        ));
        source.release_experts(&[]).unwrap();
        assert!(source.released.is_empty());
        let legacy: &mut dyn ExpertPayloadSource = &mut source;
        legacy.release_layer(9).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(source.released, vec![9]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn borrowed_source_hooks_keep_views_borrowed_and_releases_targeted() {
        use crate::expert_tier::ExpertPayloadView;

        struct Borrowed {
            bytes: [u8; 4],
            hinted: Vec<ExpertId>,
            released: Vec<ExpertId>,
        }
        impl ExpertPayloadSource for Borrowed {
            fn parts(&self) -> usize {
                1
            }
            fn payload(&mut self, _: ExpertId, _: usize) -> Result<ExpertPayload, EngError> {
                Err(EngError::Checkpoint("owned payload was requested".into()))
            }
            fn release_layer(&mut self, _: u32) -> Result<(), EngError> {
                Err(EngError::BadRequest(
                    "whole-layer release was requested".into(),
                ))
            }
            fn with_payload<R>(
                &mut self,
                _: ExpertId,
                _: usize,
                consume: impl FnOnce(ExpertPayloadView<'_>) -> Result<R, EngError>,
            ) -> Result<R, EngError> {
                consume(ExpertPayloadView {
                    data: &self.bytes,
                    scales: &[],
                    tensor_scale: 1.0,
                    shape: [1, 4],
                })
            }
            fn prefetch_experts(&mut self, ids: &[ExpertId]) -> Result<(), EngError> {
                self.hinted.extend_from_slice(ids);
                Ok(())
            }
            fn release_experts(&mut self, ids: &[ExpertId]) -> Result<(), EngError> {
                self.released.extend_from_slice(ids);
                Ok(())
            }
        }
        let mut source = Borrowed {
            bytes: [1, 2, 3, 4],
            hinted: Vec::new(),
            released: Vec::new(),
        };
        let ids = [
            ExpertId {
                layer: 7,
                expert: 1,
            },
            ExpertId {
                layer: 7,
                expert: 3,
            },
        ];
        let address = source.bytes.as_ptr();
        source.prefetch_experts(&ids).unwrap();
        let observed = source
            .with_payload(ids[0], 0, |view| Ok((view.data.as_ptr(), view.data.len())))
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(observed, (address, 4));
        source.release_experts(&ids).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(source.hinted, ids);
        assert_eq!(source.released, ids);
    }

    #[test]
    fn auto_places_the_last_layers_that_fit_and_releases_each_after_its_upload() {
        // Room for 3 layers and a half after the reserve and the headroom.
        let mut device = gpu(VRAM_HEADROOM_BYTES + 50 + 3 * LAYER + 400, 50);
        let mut source = Source::default();
        let residency = place_gpu_layers(
            GpuLayerPlan::Auto,
            &MOE,
            EXPERTS,
            LAYER,
            &mut device,
            &mut source,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(residency.full_layers(), vec![5, 8, 10]);
        assert_eq!(residency.resident_experts(), 3 * EXPERTS as usize);
        assert_eq!(
            source.released,
            vec![10, 8, 5],
            "last layer first, each once"
        );
        assert_eq!(device.uploads.len(), 3 * EXPERTS as usize * 2);
        assert_eq!(device.finished, Some(device.free));
        assert_eq!(residency.coverage(8, &[0, 3]), Coverage::Device);
        assert_eq!(residency.coverage(3, &[0]), Coverage::Host);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_fixed_count_places_exactly_that_many_or_refuses() {
        let mut device = gpu(VRAM_HEADROOM_BYTES + 10 * LAYER, 0);
        let mut source = Source::default();
        let residency = place_gpu_layers(
            GpuLayerPlan::Fixed(2),
            &MOE,
            EXPERTS,
            LAYER,
            &mut device,
            &mut source,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(residency.full_layers(), vec![8, 10]);

        let mut small = gpu(VRAM_HEADROOM_BYTES + LAYER + 50, 0);
        let refused = place_gpu_layers(
            GpuLayerPlan::Fixed(2),
            &MOE,
            EXPERTS,
            LAYER,
            &mut small,
            &mut Source::default(),
        );
        assert!(
            matches!(refused, Err(EngError::MemoryPlan(_))),
            "{refused:?}"
        );
        assert!(
            small.finished.is_none(),
            "a refused placement does not finish"
        );

        let too_many = place_gpu_layers(
            GpuLayerPlan::Fixed(6),
            &MOE,
            EXPERTS,
            LAYER,
            &mut gpu(100 * GIB, 0),
            &mut Source::default(),
        );
        assert!(matches!(too_many, Err(EngError::BadRequest(_))));
    }

    #[test]
    fn zero_layers_is_valid_and_still_finishes_the_placement() {
        let mut device = gpu(5 * GIB, 0);
        let residency = place_gpu_layers(
            GpuLayerPlan::Fixed(0),
            &MOE,
            EXPERTS,
            LAYER,
            &mut device,
            &mut Source::default(),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(residency.full_layers().is_empty());
        assert_eq!(device.finished, Some(5 * GIB));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_source_failure_stops_the_placement_before_anything_is_released_for_that_layer() {
        let mut device = gpu(100 * GIB, 0);
        let mut source = Source {
            fail_layer: Some(8),
            ..Source::default()
        };
        let outcome = place_gpu_layers(
            GpuLayerPlan::Auto,
            &MOE,
            EXPERTS,
            LAYER,
            &mut device,
            &mut source,
        );
        assert!(matches!(outcome, Err(EngError::Checkpoint(_))));
        assert_eq!(source.released, vec![10]);
        assert!(device.finished.is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn auto_fit_leaves_the_cache_and_the_vram_headroom() {
        let layer = 1512 * (1 << 20);
        // 23 GiB free, a 12 GiB dense cache still to come, 3 GiB headroom: 8 GiB / 1512 MiB = 5.
        assert_eq!(auto_fit_gpu_layers(23 * GIB, 12 * GIB, layer, 40), 5);
        // The same free memory with an 8 GiB stored-dtype dense set fits eight.
        assert_eq!(auto_fit_gpu_layers(23 * GIB, 8 * GIB, layer, 40), 8);
        // Never more than the model has, never negative, and a zero-size layer fits nothing.
        assert_eq!(auto_fit_gpu_layers(1000 * GIB, 0, layer, 40), 40);
        assert_eq!(auto_fit_gpu_layers(GIB / 2, 0, layer, 40), 0);
        assert_eq!(auto_fit_gpu_layers(23 * GIB, 30 * GIB, layer, 40), 0);
        assert_eq!(auto_fit_gpu_layers(23 * GIB, 0, 0, 40), 0);
    }
}
//! Where each decoded token spent its time, and what the tier did.

use std::time::Duration;

/// Where one decoded token spent its time. Parts overlap only where stated.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct TokenSplit {
    /// The whole `step`, embedding to greedy head.
    pub wall: Duration,
    /// CPU routed-expert kernel, summed over the CPU layers (runs beside `shared`).
    pub cpu_routed: Duration,
    /// Time the main thread waited for the CPU kernel after its shared expert finished.
    pub cpu_exposed: Duration,
    /// Shared expert through the device projector, summed over the CPU layers.
    pub shared: Duration,
    /// Routed experts of the device-resident layers.
    pub gpu_routed: Duration,
    /// Device projection calls of the whole token, uploads excluded.
    pub device_calls: Duration,
    /// Weight uploads (allocation plus host-to-device copy) of the whole token.
    pub uploads: Duration,
    pub upload_bytes: u64,
}

/// What the tier did, for a harness report.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct TierReport {
    pub cpu_threads: usize,
    pub cpu_layers: Vec<u32>,
    /// Layers whose every routed expert is device-resident.
    pub gpu_layers: Vec<u32>,
    /// Routed experts that are device-resident, whole layers or not.
    pub gpu_resident_experts: usize,
    pub gpu_resident_bytes: u64,
    pub load: Duration,
    pub tokens: Vec<TokenSplit>,
}
//! Which routed experts are device-resident, and how a layer's picks split.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;

use super::ExpertId;
use crate::EngError;

/// The persistent home of an expert, not a temporary streaming bank.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Placement {
    /// Device-resident weights.
    Gpu,
    /// Host-resident weights computed by the CPU tier.
    Cpu,
    /// The read-only mapped tail, fetched on demand.
    Nvme,
}

/// How the picks of one layer split between the device and the host.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Coverage {
    /// Every pick is device-resident (also the answer for an empty selection).
    Device,
    /// No pick is device-resident: the whole layer call belongs to the CPU kernel.
    Host,
    /// Some picks are resident and some are cold. A per-expert hot set produces this.
    Mixed,
}

/// The single persistent placement map, keyed by layer and expert.
///
/// Legacy dispatch uses [`Self::coverage`] for GPU versus host; streaming uses
/// [`Self::placement`] to leave CPU-owned experts in place. Temporary GPU banks do
/// not change an expert's persistent assignment.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct Residency {
    layers: BTreeMap<u32, Vec<Placement>>,
}

impl Residency {
    /// Classifies a source-validated id; unassigned experts belong to the mapped tail.
    pub fn placement(&self, id: ExpertId) -> Placement {
        self.layers
            .get(&id.layer)
            .and_then(|placements| placements.get(id.expert as usize))
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or(Placement::Nvme)
    }

    /// Records placement after the caller has moved the weights and released the old tier.
    pub fn set_placement(
        &mut self,
        id: ExpertId,
        experts: u32,
        placement: Placement,
    ) -> Result<(), EngError> {
        if experts == 0 || id.expert >= experts {
            return Err(EngError::BadRequest(format!(
                "expert {} is outside layer {} count {experts}",
                id.expert, id.layer
            )));
        }
        let placements = self
            .layers
            .entry(id.layer)
            .or_insert_with(|| vec![Placement::Nvme; experts as usize]);
        if placements.len() != experts as usize {
            return Err(EngError::BadRequest(format!(
                "layer {} has {} experts, not {experts}",
                id.layer,
                placements.len()
            )));
        }
        placements[id.expert as usize] = placement;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn mark_expert(&mut self, layer: u32, expert: u32, experts: u32) {
        let flags = self
            .layers
            .entry(layer)
            .or_insert_with(|| vec![Placement::Nvme; experts as usize]);
        if let Some(flag) = flags.get_mut(expert as usize) {
            *flag = Placement::Gpu;
        }
    }

    /// Splits a layer's picks (expert ids) into resident and cold ones.
    pub fn coverage(&self, layer: u32, picks: &[u32]) -> Coverage {
        let resident = |expert: u32| self.placement(ExpertId { layer, expert }) == Placement::Gpu;
        let hot = picks.iter().filter(|&&expert| resident(expert)).count();
        match hot {
            _ if hot == picks.len() => Coverage::Device,
            0 => Coverage::Host,
            _ => Coverage::Mixed,
        }
    }

    /// Whether any expert of the layer is cold, so the CPU kernel needs the layer mapped.
    pub fn has_cold(&self, layer: u32) -> bool {
        self.layers
            .get(&layer)
            .is_none_or(|flags| flags.iter().any(|&placement| placement != Placement::Gpu))
    }

    /// The layers whose every expert is resident.
    pub fn full_layers(&self) -> Vec<u32> {
        self.layers
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, flags)| flags.iter().all(|&placement| placement == Placement::Gpu))
            .map(|(layer, _)| *layer)
            .collect()
    }

    pub fn resident_experts(&self) -> usize {
        self.layers
            .values()
            .map(|flags| {
                flags
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|&&placement| placement == Placement::Gpu)
                    .count()
            })
            .sum()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::EngError;
    use crate::expert_tier::{ExpertId, Placement};

    #[test]
    fn placement_distinguishes_cpu_tail_and_gpu() {
        let mut residency = Residency::default();
        let id = ExpertId {
            layer: 7,
            expert: 1,
        };
        assert_eq!(residency.placement(id), Placement::Nvme);
        residency.set_placement(id, 4, Placement::Cpu).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(residency.placement(id), Placement::Cpu);
        assert_eq!(residency.coverage(7, &[1]), Coverage::Host);
        residency.mark_expert(7, 2, 4);
        assert_eq!(residency.coverage(7, &[1, 2]), Coverage::Mixed);
        residency.set_placement(id, 4, Placement::Gpu).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(residency.resident_experts(), 2);
        assert_eq!(residency.coverage(7, &[1, 2]), Coverage::Device);
        residency.set_placement(id, 4, Placement::Nvme).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(residency.placement(id), Placement::Nvme);
        assert_eq!(residency.resident_experts(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn invalid_placement_preserves_the_existing_assignment() {
        let mut residency = Residency::default();
        let id = ExpertId {
            layer: 7,
            expert: 1,
        };
        residency.set_placement(id, 4, Placement::Cpu).unwrap();
        for (candidate, count) in [
            (
                ExpertId {
                    layer: 7,
                    expert: 4,
                },
                4,
            ),
            (id, 0),
            (id, 3),
        ] {
            assert!(matches!(
                residency.set_placement(candidate, count, Placement::Gpu),
                Err(EngError::BadRequest(_))
            ));
            assert_eq!(residency.placement(id), Placement::Cpu);
            assert_eq!(residency.resident_experts(), 0);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn residency_answers_per_expert_and_per_layer() {
        let mut residency = Residency::default();
        // Layer 4 whole, layer 7 only experts 1 and 2 (a hot set), layer 9 nothing.
        for expert in 0..4 {
            residency.mark_expert(4, expert, 4);
        }
        residency.mark_expert(7, 1, 4);
        residency.mark_expert(7, 2, 4);
        assert_eq!(residency.coverage(4, &[0, 3]), Coverage::Device);
        assert_eq!(residency.coverage(7, &[1, 2]), Coverage::Device);
        assert_eq!(residency.coverage(7, &[0, 3]), Coverage::Host);
        assert_eq!(residency.coverage(7, &[1, 3]), Coverage::Mixed);
        assert_eq!(residency.coverage(9, &[0]), Coverage::Host);
        assert_eq!(residency.coverage(9, &[]), Coverage::Device);
        assert!(!residency.has_cold(4));
        assert!(residency.has_cold(7) && residency.has_cold(9));
        assert_eq!(residency.full_layers(), vec![4]);
        assert_eq!(residency.resident_experts(), 6);
    }
}
//! Pending two-bank transport reservations, charged through the existing placement store.

use super::{ExpertId, ExpertPayload, GpuExpertStore, VRAM_HEADROOM_BYTES};
use crate::EngError;

/// Two pinned banks, two device banks and the caller's bounded auxiliary storage.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct StreamBankPlan {
    bank_bytes: u64,
    device_bytes: u64,
    host_bytes: u64,
}

impl StreamBankPlan {
    /// Auxiliary bytes cover descriptors/status/scratch not already reserved.
    /// Host scratch includes any temporary owned payload from the source.
    pub fn new(
        bank_bytes: u64,
        device_aux_bytes: u64,
        host_scratch_bytes: u64,
    ) -> Result<Self, EngError> {
        if bank_bytes == 0 {
            return Err(EngError::BadRequest(
                "streaming bank bytes must be positive".into(),
            ));
        }
        let pair = bank_bytes.checked_mul(2).ok_or_else(overflow)?;
        Ok(Self {
            bank_bytes,
            device_bytes: pair.checked_add(device_aux_bytes).ok_or_else(overflow)?,
            host_bytes: pair.checked_add(host_scratch_bytes).ok_or_else(overflow)?,
        })
    }

    pub fn bank_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.bank_bytes
    }

    pub fn device_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.device_bytes
    }

    pub fn host_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.host_bytes
    }

    /// Reserve before hot placement; allocate the banks after this wrapper is released.
    /// The caller's host budget must already exclude model memory and desktop headroom.
    pub fn reserve<'a, G: GpuExpertStore>(
        self,
        gpu: &'a mut G,
        host_budget: u64,
    ) -> Result<impl GpuExpertStore + 'a, EngError> {
        if self.host_bytes > host_budget {
            return Err(EngError::MemoryPlan(format!(
                "streaming banks need {} host bytes, budget is {host_budget}",
                self.host_bytes
            )));
        }
        check_free(gpu.free_bytes()?, gpu.reserved_bytes(), self.device_bytes)?;
        Ok(ReservedStore {
            gpu,
            pending: self.device_bytes,
        })
    }
}

fn overflow() -> EngError {
    EngError::MemoryPlan("streaming bank reservation byte count overflow".into())
}

fn check_free(free: u64, reserved: u64, pending: u64) -> Result<(), EngError> {
    let required = reserved
        .checked_add(pending)
        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(VRAM_HEADROOM_BYTES))
        .ok_or_else(overflow)?;
    if free < required {
        return Err(EngError::MemoryPlan(format!(
            "device reserves need {required} bytes including headroom, only {free} free"
        )));
    }
    Ok(())
}

struct ReservedStore<'a, G: GpuExpertStore> {
    gpu: &'a mut G,
    pending: u64,
}

impl<G: GpuExpertStore> GpuExpertStore for ReservedStore<'_, G> {
    fn upload(
        &mut self,
        id: ExpertId,
        part: usize,
        payload: &ExpertPayload,
    ) -> Result<(), EngError> {
        self.gpu.upload(id, part, payload)
    }

    fn free_bytes(&self) -> Result<u64, EngError> {
        self.gpu.free_bytes()
    }

    fn reserved_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.gpu.reserved_bytes().saturating_add(self.pending)
    }

    fn finish_placement(&mut self, free_bytes: u64) -> Result<(), EngError> {
        check_free(free_bytes, self.gpu.reserved_bytes(), self.pending)?;
        // The dense cache must not consume the banks' still-unallocated reservation.
        self.gpu.finish_placement(free_bytes - self.pending)
    }
}
//! Two bounded transport slots for the canonical NVMe tail, never a residency policy.
//! All GPU reads of a lease's parts must use its stream. Finish before consuming
//! results; kernel-specific numerical status checks remain the format adapter's job.
//! A dropped lease also waits, so the slot cannot overwrite an outstanding consumer.

use std::ops::Range;

use super::{
    ExpertId, ExpertPayloadSource, ExpertPayloadView, Placement, Residency, StreamBankPlan,
};
use crate::EngError;
use crate::kernels::cuda::{
    CudaContext, DeviceBuffer, DeviceEvent, DeviceRange, DeviceStream, PinnedBuf,
};

// Preserve CUDA allocation alignment for every packed/scales subrange.
const ALIGN: usize = 256;

pub(crate) struct CudaStreamBanks {
    slots: [CudaStreamBank; 2],
}

pub(crate) struct CudaStreamBank {
    host: PinnedBuf,
    device: DeviceBuffer,
    transfer: DeviceStream,
    compute: DeviceStream,
    ready: DeviceEvent,
    done: DeviceEvent,
    parts: Vec<Part>,
    used: usize,
    scratch_limit: usize,
    poisoned: bool,
    #[cfg(test)]
    timing: Option<super::stream_cuda_profile::Pair>,
}

struct Part {
    key: (ExpertId, usize),
    data: Range<usize>,
    scales: Option<Range<usize>>,
    tensor_scale: f32,
    shape: [u32; 2],
}

pub(crate) struct StreamedPart<'a> {
    pub(crate) data: DeviceRange<'a>,
    pub(crate) scales: Option<DeviceRange<'a>>,
    pub(crate) tensor_scale: f32,
    pub(crate) shape: [u32; 2],
}

#[must_use = "finish the bank lease and check kernel status before consuming output"]
pub(crate) struct CudaBankLease<'a> {
    bank: &'a mut CudaStreamBank,
    finished: bool,
}

fn bad(message: &str) -> EngError {
    EngError::BadRequest(format!("expert streaming: {message}"))
}

fn capacity() -> EngError {
    EngError::MemoryPlan("expert streaming exceeds its admitted bank or host scratch".into())
}

impl CudaStreamBanks {
    /// Use the plan's reservation for hot placement first; allocate after releasing that wrapper.
    /// Host scratch covers demand ids, part metadata and one temporary payload per slot.
    pub(crate) fn new(ctx: &CudaContext, plan: StreamBankPlan) -> Result<Self, EngError> {
        let bytes = usize::try_from(plan.bank_bytes()).map_err(|_| capacity())?;
        let scratch = plan.host_bytes() - 2 * plan.bank_bytes();
        let limit = usize::try_from(scratch / 2).map_err(|_| capacity())?;
        Ok(Self {
            slots: [
                CudaStreamBank::new(ctx, bytes, limit)?,
                CudaStreamBank::new(ctx, bytes, limit)?,
            ],
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn slots_mut(&mut self) -> (&mut CudaStreamBank, &mut CudaStreamBank) {
        let [a, b] = &mut self.slots;
        (a, b)
    }
}

impl CudaStreamBank {
    fn new(ctx: &CudaContext, bytes: usize, scratch_limit: usize) -> Result<Self, EngError> {
        Ok(Self {
            host: ctx.pinned_buf(bytes)?,
            device: ctx.allocate(bytes)?,
            transfer: ctx.stream()?,
            compute: ctx.stream()?,
            ready: ctx.event()?,
            done: ctx.event()?,
            parts: Vec::new(),
            used: 0,
            scratch_limit,
            poisoned: false,
            #[cfg(test)]
            timing: None,
        })
    }

    /// Stage only the NVMe subset. GPU/CPU assignments stay in their canonical tiers.
    /// The allocating context must be supplied; its typed copy API checks ownership.
    #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]
    pub(crate) fn stage<'a, S: ExpertPayloadSource>(
        &'a mut self,
        ctx: &CudaContext,
        source: &mut S,
        residency: &Residency,
        demand: &[ExpertId],
    ) -> Result<Option<CudaBankLease<'a>>, EngError> {
        let ids = tail_ids(residency, demand, self.scratch_limit)?;
        self.stage_ids(ctx, source, ids)
    }

    /// Stage every demanded expert (the prefill stream): placement tiers are
    /// untouched — this is a per-chunk transport, not a residency decision.
    pub(crate) fn stage_demand<'a, S: ExpertPayloadSource>(
        &'a mut self,
        ctx: &CudaContext,
        source: &mut S,
        demand: &[ExpertId],
    ) -> Result<Option<CudaBankLease<'a>>, EngError> {
        let ids = demand_ids(demand, self.scratch_limit)?;
        self.stage_ids(ctx, source, ids)
    }

    fn stage_ids<'a, S: ExpertPayloadSource>(
        &'a mut self,
        ctx: &CudaContext,
        source: &mut S,
        ids: Vec<ExpertId>,
    ) -> Result<Option<CudaBankLease<'a>>, EngError> {
        ctx.ensure_usable()?;
        if self.poisoned {
            return Err(bad("a previous bank completion failed"));
        }
        // Free previous metadata before allocating this refill's admitted scratch.
        self.parts = Vec::new();
        self.used = 0;
        if ids.is_empty() {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        let ids_bytes = ids
            .capacity()
            .checked_mul(size_of::<ExpertId>())
            .ok_or_else(capacity)?;
        let scratch = self
            .scratch_limit
            .checked_sub(ids_bytes)
            .ok_or_else(capacity)?;
        let (parts, used) = prepare(&mut self.host, source, &ids, scratch)?;
        // The source is no longer borrowed: DMA reads only our owned pinned bytes.
        source.release_experts(&ids)?;
        self.copy(ctx, used)?;
        self.parts = parts;
        self.used = used;
        Ok(Some(CudaBankLease {
            bank: self,
            finished: false,
        }))
    }

    fn copy(&mut self, ctx: &CudaContext, used: usize) -> Result<(), EngError> {
        #[cfg(test)]
        let mut timing = super::stream_cuda_profile::begin(ctx, &self.transfer, used)?;
        ctx.copy_from_pinned(
            &self.transfer,
            &mut self.host,
            0,
            self.device.range(0, used)?,
        )?;
        #[cfg(test)]
        {
            super::stream_cuda_profile::end(&self.transfer, &mut timing)?;
            self.timing = timing;
        }
        let ordered = self
            .transfer
            .record(&self.ready)
            .and_then(|_| self.compute.wait(&self.ready));
        if ordered.is_err() {
            self.poisoned = true;
        }
        ordered
    }

    fn complete(&mut self) -> Result<(), EngError> {
        let outcome = (|| {
            self.compute.record(&self.done)?;
            self.done.synchronize()?;
            self.host.wait(&self.ready)
        })();
        #[cfg(test)]
        {
            let timing = self.timing.take();
            if outcome.is_ok() {
                super::stream_cuda_profile::complete(timing);
            }
        }
        if outcome.is_err() {
            self.poisoned = true;
        }
        outcome
    }
}

#[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]
fn tail_ids(
    residency: &Residency,
    demand: &[ExpertId],
    limit: usize,
) -> Result<Vec<ExpertId>, EngError> {
    let tail = |id: &&ExpertId| residency.placement(**id) == Placement::Nvme;
    let count = demand.iter().filter(tail).count();
    let bytes = count
        .checked_mul(size_of::<ExpertId>())
        .ok_or_else(capacity)?;
    if bytes > limit {
        return Err(capacity());
    }
    let mut ids = Vec::new();
    ids.try_reserve_exact(count).map_err(|_| capacity())?;
    ids.extend(demand.iter().filter(tail).copied());
    ids.sort_unstable();
    ids.dedup();
    Ok(ids)
}

/// The prefill stream's demand set: every demanded expert regardless of
/// placement — streaming is a per-chunk transport, never a residency tier.
fn demand_ids(demand: &[ExpertId], limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<ExpertId>, EngError> {
    let mut ids = Vec::new();
    ids.try_reserve_exact(demand.len())
        .map_err(|_| capacity())?;
    ids.extend(demand.iter().copied());
    ids.sort_unstable();
    ids.dedup();
    if ids
        .capacity()
        .checked_mul(size_of::<ExpertId>())
        .is_some_and(|bytes| bytes > limit)
    {
        return Err(capacity());
    }
    Ok(ids)
}

fn prepare<S: ExpertPayloadSource>(
    host: &mut PinnedBuf,
    source: &mut S,
    ids: &[ExpertId],
    scratch: usize,
) -> Result<(Vec<Part>, usize), EngError> {
    let per_expert = source.parts();
    if per_expert == 0 {
        return Err(bad("an expert must have at least one part"));
    }
    let count = ids.len().checked_mul(per_expert).ok_or_else(capacity)?;
    let mut parts = Vec::new();
    let metadata = count.checked_mul(size_of::<Part>()).ok_or_else(capacity)?;
    if metadata > scratch {
        return Err(capacity());
    }
    parts.try_reserve_exact(count).map_err(|_| capacity())?;
    let metadata = parts
        .capacity()
        .checked_mul(size_of::<Part>())
        .ok_or_else(capacity)?;
    let payload_budget = scratch.checked_sub(metadata).ok_or_else(capacity)?;
    source.prefetch_experts(ids)?;
    let mut used = 0;
    for &id in ids {
        for index in 0..per_expert {
            let (part, end) = source.with_payload(id, index, |view| {
                let bytes = view
                    .data
                    .len()
                    .checked_add(view.scales.len())
                    .ok_or_else(capacity)?;
                if bytes > payload_budget {
                    return Err(capacity());
                }
                pack_part(host, used, (id, index), view)
            })?;
            parts.push(part);
            used = end;
        }
    }
    Ok((parts, used))
}

fn pack_part(
    host: &mut PinnedBuf,
    used: usize,
    key: (ExpertId, usize),
    view: ExpertPayloadView<'_>,
) -> Result<(Part, usize), EngError> {
    if view.data.is_empty() || view.shape.contains(&0) {
        return Err(bad("expert parts need data and positive matrix dimensions"));
    }
    let start = used.checked_next_multiple_of(ALIGN).ok_or_else(capacity)?;
    let end = start.checked_add(view.data.len()).ok_or_else(capacity)?;
    let (scales, used) = if view.scales.is_empty() {
        (None, end)
    } else {
        let start = end.checked_next_multiple_of(ALIGN).ok_or_else(capacity)?;
        let end = start.checked_add(view.scales.len()).ok_or_else(capacity)?;
        (Some(start..end), end)
    };
    if used > host.len() {
        return Err(capacity());
    }
    host.write(start, view.data)?;
    if let Some(range) = &scales {
        host.write(range.start, view.scales)?;
    }
    Ok((
        Part {
            key,
            data: start..end,
            scales,
            tensor_scale: view.tensor_scale,
            shape: view.shape,
        },
        used,
    ))
}

impl CudaBankLease<'_> {
    /// Queue every consumer of the bank on this stream; capture/replay is unsupported.
    pub(crate) fn stream(&self) -> &DeviceStream {
        &self.bank.compute
    }

    #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]
    pub(crate) fn bytes(&self) -> usize {
        self.bank.used
    }

    pub(crate) fn part(&self, id: ExpertId, index: usize) -> Result<StreamedPart<'_>, EngError> {
        let position = self
            .bank
            .parts
            .binary_search_by_key(&(id, index), |part| part.key)
            .map_err(|_| bad("the requested expert part is not in this bank lease"))?;
        let part = &self.bank.parts[position];
        Ok(StreamedPart {
            data: self
                .bank
                .device
                .range(part.data.start, part.data.end - part.data.start)?,
            scales: part
                .scales
                .as_ref()
                .map(|range| self.bank.device.range(range.start, range.end - range.start))
                .transpose()?,
            tensor_scale: part.tensor_scale,
            shape: part.shape,
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn finish(mut self) -> Result<(), EngError> {
        let outcome = self.bank.complete();
        self.finished = true;
        outcome
    }
}

impl Drop for CudaBankLease<'_> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if !self.finished {
            let _ = self.bank.complete();
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::CudaBankLease;
    use crate::EngError;
    use crate::expert_tier::{
        CudaStreamBanks, ExpertId, ExpertPayload, ExpertPayloadSource, ExpertPayloadView,
        Placement, Residency, StreamBankPlan,
    };
    use crate::kernels::cuda::{CudaContext, DeviceEvent, PinnedBuf};

    struct Source {
        data: Vec<Vec<u8>>,
        reads: Vec<ExpertId>,
        released: Vec<ExpertId>,
    }

    impl ExpertPayloadSource for Source {
        fn parts(&self) -> usize {
            1
        }
        fn payload(&mut self, _: ExpertId, _: usize) -> Result<ExpertPayload, EngError> {
            Err(EngError::Checkpoint("owned payload was requested".into()))
        }
        fn release_layer(&mut self, _: u32) -> Result<(), EngError> {
            Err(EngError::BadRequest(
                "whole-layer release was requested".into(),
            ))
        }
        fn with_payload<R>(
            &mut self,
            id: ExpertId,
            _: usize,
            consume: impl FnOnce(ExpertPayloadView<'_>) -> Result<R, EngError>,
        ) -> Result<R, EngError> {
            self.reads.push(id);
            let data = self
                .data
                .get(id.expert as usize)
                .ok_or_else(|| EngError::Checkpoint("unknown expert".into()))?;
            consume(ExpertPayloadView {
                data,
                scales: &[17],
                tensor_scale: 1.0,
                shape: [1, data.len() as u32],
            })
        }
        fn release_experts(&mut self, ids: &[ExpertId]) -> Result<(), EngError> {
            self.released.extend_from_slice(ids);
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    fn queue_read(
        ctx: &CudaContext,
        lease: &CudaBankLease<'_>,
        id: ExpertId,
        out: &mut PinnedBuf,
    ) -> Result<DeviceEvent, EngError> {
        let done = ctx.event()?;
        let part = lease.part(id, 0)?;
        ctx.copy_to_pinned(lease.stream(), part.data, out, 0)?;
        lease.stream().record(&done)?;
        Ok(done)
    }

    fn read(out: &mut PinnedBuf, done: &DeviceEvent) -> Result<Vec<u8>, EngError> {
        out.wait(done)?;
        let mut bytes = vec![0; out.len()];
        out.read(0, &mut bytes)?;
        Ok(bytes)
    }

    fn missing() -> EngError {
        EngError::BadRequest("expected an NVMe bank".into())
    }

    #[test]
    fn two_banks_copy_in_order_and_filter_persistent_tiers() {
        let observed = (|| -> Result<_, EngError> {
            let capture = super::super::stream_cuda_profile::Capture::start();
            let ctx = CudaContext::new()?;
            let mut banks = CudaStreamBanks::new(&ctx, StreamBankPlan::new(1024, 0, 4096)?)?;
            let mut out_a = ctx.pinned_buf(4)?;
            let mut out_b = ctx.pinned_buf(4)?;
            let mut scale = ctx.pinned_buf(1)?;
            let ids = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(|expert| ExpertId { layer: 7, expert });
            let mut placement = Residency::default();
            placement.mark_expert(7, 0, 4);
            placement.set_placement(ids[3], 4, Placement::Cpu)?;
            let mut source = Source {
                data: vec![vec![0; 4], vec![1, 2, 3, 4], vec![5, 6, 7, 8], vec![9; 4]],
                reads: Vec::new(),
                released: Vec::new(),
            };
            let (a, b) = banks.slots_mut();
            let a_lease = a
                .stage(
                    &ctx,
                    &mut source,
                    &placement,
                    &[ids[0], ids[1], ids[3], ids[1]],
                )?
                .ok_or_else(missing)?;
            let bytes = a_lease.bytes();
            let metadata = (
                a_lease.part(ids[1], 0)?.shape,
                a_lease.part(ids[1], 0)?.tensor_scale,
            );
            let a_done = queue_read(&ctx, &a_lease, ids[1], &mut out_a)?;
            let a_scales = a_lease.part(ids[1], 0)?.scales.ok_or_else(missing)?;
            ctx.copy_to_pinned(a_lease.stream(), a_scales, &mut scale, 0)?;
            a_lease.stream().record(&a_done)?;
            let mut early = [0; 4];
            let premature = out_a.read(0, &mut early);
            // The first consumer is still outstanding while the second bank stages.
            let b_lease = b
                .stage(&ctx, &mut source, &placement, &[ids[2]])?
                .ok_or_else(missing)?;
            let b_done = queue_read(&ctx, &b_lease, ids[2], &mut out_b)?;
            let second = read(&mut out_b, &b_done)?;
            let first = read(&mut out_a, &a_done)?;
            let scales = read(&mut scale, &a_done)?;
            drop(a_lease);
            b_lease.finish()?;
            let again = a
                .stage(&ctx, &mut source, &placement, &[ids[2]])?
                .ok_or_else(missing)?;
            let stale = again.part(ids[1], 0).map(|_| ());
            let again_done = queue_read(&ctx, &again, ids[2], &mut out_a)?;
            let third = read(&mut out_a, &again_done)?;
            again.finish()?;
            ctx.ensure_usable()?;
            Ok((
                first,
                second,
                third,
                scales,
                premature,
                stale,
                source.reads,
                source.released,
                bytes,
                metadata,
                capture.finish()?,
            ))
        })();
        let (
            first,
            second,
            third,
            scales,
            premature,
            stale,
            reads,
            released,
            bytes,
            metadata,
            bank,
        ) = observed.expect("two owned streaming banks");
        assert_eq!(first, [1, 2, 3, 4]);
        assert_eq!(second, [5, 6, 7, 8]);
        assert_eq!(third, second);
        assert_eq!(scales, [17]);
        assert_eq!(metadata, ([1, 4], 1.0));
        assert!(matches!(premature, Err(EngError::BadRequest(_))));
        assert!(matches!(stale, Err(EngError::BadRequest(_))));
        let expected = [1, 2, 2].map(|expert| ExpertId { layer: 7, expert });
        assert_eq!(reads, expected);
        assert_eq!(released, expected);
        assert_eq!(bytes, 257);
        assert_eq!(bank.calls, 3);
        assert_eq!(bank.dma_bytes, 3 * bytes as u64);
        assert!(bank.gpu_ms.is_finite() && bank.gpu_ms >= 0.0);
        assert!(bank.event_api_host_ns > 0);
    }
}
//! Test-only bank transfer timing, queried after the lease's existing completion wait.
use crate::{
    EngError,
    kernels::cuda::{CudaContext, DeviceStream, TimingEvent},
};
use serde::Serialize;
use std::{cell::RefCell, rc::Rc, time::Instant};

#[derive(Default, Serialize)]
pub(crate) struct Report {
    pub(crate) calls: u64,
    pub(crate) dma_bytes: u64,
    pub(crate) gpu_ms: f64,
    pub(crate) event_api_host_ns: u64,
}

impl Report {
    fn add(&mut self, bytes: u64, ms: f32, ns: u64) {
        assert!(
            ms.is_finite() && ms >= 0.0,
            "invalid CUDA bank timing interval"
        );
        self.calls += 1;
        self.dma_bytes += bytes;
        self.gpu_ms += f64::from(ms);
        self.event_api_host_ns += ns;
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct State {
    inflight: u64,
    completed: Vec<Events>,
}

thread_local! {
    static ACTIVE: RefCell<Option<Rc<RefCell<State>>>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
}

pub(crate) struct Capture(Rc<RefCell<State>>);

impl Capture {
    pub(crate) fn start() -> Self {
        ACTIVE.with_borrow_mut(|active| {
            assert!(active.is_none(), "nested bank capture");
            let state = Rc::new(RefCell::new(State::default()));
            *active = Some(Rc::clone(&state));
            Self(state)
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn finish(&self) -> Result<Report, EngError> {
        let completed = {
            let mut state = self.0.borrow_mut();
            assert_eq!(state.inflight, 0, "bank lease must finish before capture");
            std::mem::take(&mut state.completed)
        };
        let mut report = Report::default();
        for events in completed {
            let host = Instant::now();
            let ms = events.begin.elapsed_ms_since(&events.end)?;
            let (bytes, previous) = (events.bytes, events.host_ns);
            drop(events);
            report.add(bytes, ms, previous + host.elapsed().as_nanos() as u64);
        }
        Ok(report)
    }
}

impl Drop for Capture {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        ACTIVE.with_borrow_mut(|active| *active = None);
    }
}

struct Events {
    begin: TimingEvent,
    end: TimingEvent,
    bytes: u64,
    host_ns: u64,
}

pub(crate) struct Pair {
    events: Option<Events>,
    state: Rc<RefCell<State>>,
}

pub(crate) fn begin(
    ctx: &CudaContext,
    stream: &DeviceStream,
    bytes: usize,
) -> Result<Option<Pair>, EngError> {
    let Some(state) = ACTIVE.with_borrow(Clone::clone) else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let host = Instant::now();
    let begin = ctx.event_timing()?;
    let end = ctx.event_timing()?;
    stream.record_timing(&begin)?;
    state.borrow_mut().inflight += 1;
    Ok(Some(Pair {
        events: Some(Events {
            begin,
            end,
            bytes: bytes as u64,
            host_ns: host.elapsed().as_nanos() as u64,
        }),
        state,
    }))
}

pub(crate) fn end(stream: &DeviceStream, pair: &mut Option<Pair>) -> Result<(), EngError> {
    if let Some(pair) = pair {
        let events = pair.events.as_mut().expect("uncompleted bank timing pair");
        let host = Instant::now();
        stream.record_timing(&events.end)?;
        events.host_ns += host.elapsed().as_nanos() as u64;
    }
    Ok(())
}

// Called only after the existing bank completion wait; no additional synchronization.
pub(crate) fn complete(pair: Option<Pair>) {
    if let Some(mut pair) = pair {
        let events = pair.events.take().expect("uncompleted bank timing pair");
        let mut state = pair.state.borrow_mut();
        state.inflight -= 1;
        state.completed.push(events);
    }
}

impl Drop for Pair {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if self.events.is_some() {
            self.state.borrow_mut().inflight -= 1;
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn counters_reject_invalid_intervals_and_count_aligned_dma_once() {
    let mut report = Report::default();
    report.add(257, 1.5, 7);
    report.add(513, 0.0, 11);
    assert_eq!(
        (
            report.calls,
            report.dma_bytes,
            report.gpu_ms,
            report.event_api_host_ns
        ),
        (2, 770, 1.5, 18)
    );
    for ms in [f32::NAN, f32::INFINITY, -1.0] {
        assert!(std::panic::catch_unwind(|| Report::default().add(1, ms, 0)).is_err());
    }
}

#[test]
fn capture_resets_and_rejects_unfinished_leases_without_querying_events() {
    let capture = Capture::start();
    assert!(std::panic::catch_unwind(Capture::start).is_err());
    capture.0.borrow_mut().inflight = 1;
    assert!(std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| capture.finish())).is_err());
    capture.0.borrow_mut().inflight = 0;
    assert_eq!(capture.finish().unwrap().calls, 0);
    drop(capture);
    assert!(ACTIVE.with_borrow(Option::is_none));
    assert_eq!(Capture::start().finish().unwrap().dma_bytes, 0);
}
//! The NVFP4 GPU callback over typed bank or hot-resident ranges.

use crate::EngError;
use crate::kernels::cuda::{CudaContext, DeviceStream, Nvfp4WeightRange};

fn memory() -> EngError {
    EngError::MemoryPlan("NVFP4 routed batch buffer size or allocation exceeds capacity".into())
}

/// Returns one output row per supplied pair, in that exact order.
/// The caller admits pair I/O, immutable descriptors and status in addition to the banks.
pub(crate) fn project(
    ctx: &CudaContext,
    stream: &DeviceStream,
    weights: &[Nvfp4WeightRange<'_>],
    inputs: &[f32],
) -> Result<Vec<f32>, EngError> {
    let shape = weights
        .first()
        .ok_or_else(|| EngError::BadRequest("NVFP4 routed batch needs a pair".into()))?
        .shape();
    let output_count = weights.len().checked_mul(shape[0]).ok_or_else(memory)?;
    let output = launch(ctx, stream, weights, inputs)?;
    read_f32_rows(ctx, stream, &output, output_count)
}

/// The grouped launch with host inputs; the output stays ON the device (the
/// activation between the up and down projections never crosses to the host).
pub(crate) fn launch_host_input(
    ctx: &CudaContext,
    stream: &DeviceStream,
    weights: &[Nvfp4WeightRange<'_>],
    inputs: &[f32],
) -> Result<crate::kernels::cuda::DeviceBuffer, EngError> {
    launch(ctx, stream, weights, inputs)
}

/// The grouped launch reading its input from a device buffer, output on the
/// device as well - the down projection of the streamed expert chunk.
pub(crate) fn launch_device_input(
    ctx: &CudaContext,
    stream: &DeviceStream,
    weights: &[Nvfp4WeightRange<'_>],
    inputs: &crate::kernels::cuda::DeviceBuffer,
    input_bytes: usize,
) -> Result<crate::kernels::cuda::DeviceBuffer, EngError> {
    ctx.ensure_usable()?;
    let shape = weights
        .first()
        .ok_or_else(|| EngError::BadRequest("NVFP4 routed batch needs a pair".into()))?
        .shape();
    let count = weights.len().checked_mul(shape[1]).ok_or_else(memory)?;
    if input_bytes != count.checked_mul(size_of::<f32>()).ok_or_else(memory)? {
        return Err(EngError::BadRequest(
            "NVFP4 routed batch device input has the wrong byte count".into(),
        ));
    }
    grouped_enqueue(ctx, stream, weights, inputs.range(0, input_bytes)?)
}

fn launch(
    ctx: &CudaContext,
    stream: &DeviceStream,
    weights: &[Nvfp4WeightRange<'_>],
    inputs: &[f32],
) -> Result<crate::kernels::cuda::DeviceBuffer, EngError> {
    ctx.ensure_usable()?;
    let shape = weights
        .first()
        .ok_or_else(|| EngError::BadRequest("NVFP4 routed batch needs a pair".into()))?
        .shape();
    let count = weights.len().checked_mul(shape[1]).ok_or_else(memory)?;
    if inputs.len() != count || inputs.iter().any(|value| !value.is_finite()) {
        return Err(EngError::BadRequest(
            "NVFP4 routed batch needs one finite input row per pair".into(),
        ));
    }
    let input_bytes = count.checked_mul(size_of::<f32>()).ok_or_else(memory)?;
    let mut encoded = Vec::new();
    encoded
        .try_reserve_exact(input_bytes)
        .map_err(|_| memory())?;
    encoded.extend(inputs.iter().flat_map(|value| value.to_ne_bytes()));
    let input = ctx.upload(&encoded)?;
    grouped_enqueue(ctx, stream, weights, input.range(0, input_bytes)?)
}

fn grouped_enqueue(
    ctx: &CudaContext,
    stream: &DeviceStream,
    weights: &[Nvfp4WeightRange<'_>],
    input: crate::kernels::cuda::DeviceRange<'_>,
) -> Result<crate::kernels::cuda::DeviceBuffer, EngError> {
    let shape = weights
        .first()
        .ok_or_else(|| EngError::BadRequest("NVFP4 routed batch needs a pair".into()))?
        .shape();
    let output_count = weights.len().checked_mul(shape[0]).ok_or_else(memory)?;
    let output_bytes = output_count
        .checked_mul(size_of::<f32>())
        .ok_or_else(memory)?;
    let mut status = ctx.nvfp4_launch_status(stream)?;
    let plan = ctx.nvfp4_grouped_plan(weights)?;
    let output = ctx.allocate(output_bytes)?;
    let done = ctx.event()?;
    ctx.nvfp4_grouped_enqueue(
        stream,
        &plan,
        input,
        output.range(0, output_bytes)?,
        &mut status,
    )?;
    stream.record(&done)?;
    // A completed transfer alone cannot certify the kernel's numerical result.
    status.check(stream, &done)?;
    Ok(output)
}

pub(crate) fn read_f32_rows(
    _ctx: &CudaContext,
    stream: &DeviceStream,
    output: &crate::kernels::cuda::DeviceBuffer,
    output_count: usize,
) -> Result<Vec<f32>, EngError> {
    let output_bytes = output_count
        .checked_mul(size_of::<f32>())
        .ok_or_else(memory)?;
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    bytes
        .try_reserve_exact(output_bytes)
        .map_err(|_| memory())?;
    bytes.resize(output_bytes, 0);
    output.read_at(stream, 0, &mut bytes)?;
    let mut result = Vec::new();
    result
        .try_reserve_exact(output_count)
        .map_err(|_| memory())?;
    result.extend(
        bytes
            .as_chunks::<4>()
            .0
            .iter()
            .map(|v| f32::from_ne_bytes(*v)),
    );
    Ok(result)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::project;
    use crate::EngError;
    use crate::expert_tier::{
        CudaStreamBanks, ExpertId, ExpertPayload, ExpertPayloadSource, Residency, StreamBankPlan,
    };
    use crate::kernels::cuda::CudaContext;

    struct Payloads(Vec<ExpertPayload>);

    impl ExpertPayloadSource for Payloads {
        fn parts(&self) -> usize {
            1
        }
        fn payload(&mut self, id: ExpertId, _: usize) -> Result<ExpertPayload, EngError> {
            self.0
                .get(id.expert as usize)
                .cloned()
                .ok_or_else(|| EngError::Checkpoint("unknown routed expert".into()))
        }
        fn release_layer(&mut self, _: u32) -> Result<(), EngError> {
            Err(EngError::BadRequest(
                "whole-layer release is not used".into(),
            ))
        }
        fn release_experts(&mut self, _: &[ExpertId]) -> Result<(), EngError> {
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn bank_ranges_keep_the_routed_pair_order() {
        let observed = (|| -> Result<_, EngError> {
            let ctx = CudaContext::new()?;
            let mut banks = CudaStreamBanks::new(&ctx, StreamBankPlan::new(1024, 0, 4096)?)?;
            let mut source = Payloads(
                [0x11, 0x22]
                    .map(|code| ExpertPayload {
                        data: vec![code; 256],
                        scales: vec![0x38; 32],
                        tensor_scale: 1.0,
                        shape: [16, 32],
                    })
                    .to_vec(),
            );
            let pairs = [1, 0, 1].map(|expert| ExpertId { layer: 5, expert });
            let (bank, _) = banks.slots_mut();
            let lease = bank
                .stage(&ctx, &mut source, &Residency::default(), &pairs)?
                .ok_or_else(|| EngError::BadRequest("expected tail weights".into()))?;
            let weights = pairs
                .iter()
                .map(|&id| {
                    let part = lease.part(id, 0)?;
                    ctx.nvfp4_weight_range(
                        part.data,
                        part.scales
                            .ok_or_else(|| EngError::Checkpoint("missing NVFP4 scales".into()))?,
                        part.tensor_scale,
                        part.shape.map(|v| v as usize),
                    )
                })
                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, EngError>>()?;
            let input: Vec<f32> = [0.125, 0.5, -0.25]
                .into_iter()
                .flat_map(|value| std::iter::repeat_n(value, 32))
                .collect();
            let output = project(&ctx, lease.stream(), &weights, &input)?;
            let mismatch = project(&ctx, lease.stream(), &weights, &input[..95]);
            drop(weights);
            lease.finish()?;
            ctx.ensure_usable()?;
            Ok((output, mismatch))
        })();
        let (output, mismatch) = observed.expect("NVFP4 projection from owned bank ranges");
        let expected: Vec<f32> = [4.0, 8.0, -8.0]
            .into_iter()
            .flat_map(|value| std::iter::repeat_n(value, 16))
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(output, expected);
        assert!(matches!(mismatch, Err(EngError::BadRequest(_))));
    }
}
use serde_json::Value;

use crate::{EngError, checkpoint_json::UniqueValue, kernels::QuantizationMode};

use super::{
    quantization::QuantizationMap,
    spec::{Act, AttentionKind, FamilySpec, Router},
};

/// The reference default for `full_attention_interval` (`qwen3_5.py:43`).
const DEFAULT_FULL_ATTENTION_INTERVAL: u32 = 4;

impl FamilySpec {
    /// Checks architecture before enforcing this family's quantization metadata.
    pub fn check_config(&self, config: &[u8]) -> Result<(), EngError> {
        self.check_architecture_config(config)?;
        self.check_quantization(config)
    }

    /// Checks checkpoint architecture against this family, without a weight encoding.
    ///
    /// Executor load paths call this before resolving weights. Any value that differs from
    /// this constant, or that the configuration omits, returns `EngError::Checkpoint`.
    /// The check reads `text_config` when it exists and the root object otherwise.
    /// It rejects duplicate members and a null `head_dim`.
    /// An absent `full_attention_interval` defaults to 4, as in the pinned reference, and a
    /// present `layer_types` must equal the order that interval gives.
    /// The configuration vocabulary names only `full_attention` and `linear_attention`, so a
    /// family may execute the full-attention positions as `AttentionKind::Qsa`.
    /// The `mtp` flag selects an execution mode and has no configuration field to check.
    ///
    pub(crate) fn check_architecture_config(&self, config: &[u8]) -> Result<(), EngError> {
        let root = serde_json::from_slice::<UniqueValue>(config)
            .map_err(|error| EngError::Checkpoint(format!("configuration JSON: {error}")))?
            .0;
        let text = root.get("text_config").unwrap_or(&root);
        if !text.is_object() {
            return Err(EngError::Checkpoint(
                "configuration requires a JSON object".into(),
            ));
        }
        let fields = Fields {
            family: self.name,
            object: text,
        };
        super::keys::validate_family(self)?;
        self.check_model_type(&root, &fields)?;
        self.check_dimensions(&fields)?;
        self.check_switches(&fields)?;
        self.check_routing(&fields)?;
        self.check_layer_kinds(&fields)?;
        self.check_linear(&fields)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn check_dimensions(&self, fields: &Fields) -> Result<(), EngError> {
        let hidden = fields.expect_u32("hidden_size", self.hidden)?;
        let heads_q = fields.expect_u32("num_attention_heads", self.heads_q)?;
        fields.expect_u32("num_hidden_layers", self.layers)?;
        fields.expect_u32("num_key_value_heads", self.heads_kv)?;
        fields.expect_u32("vocab_size", self.vocab)?;
        if let Some(dense) = self.feed_forward {
            fields.expect_u32("intermediate_size", dense.intermediate)?;
            fields.expect_u32("max_position_embeddings", dense.context_limit)?;
            for name in [
                "num_experts",
                "num_experts_per_tok",
                "moe_intermediate_size",
                "shared_expert_intermediate_size",
                "norm_topk_prob",
            ] {
                fields.reject(name)?;
            }
        } else {
            // Existing MoE families tolerate a stray intermediate_size; only the dense arm
            // reads it, and refusing it here would change what main accepts.
            fields.expect_u32("num_experts", self.experts)?;
            fields.expect_u32("num_experts_per_tok", self.top_k)?;
            fields.expect_u32("moe_intermediate_size", self.moe_inter)?;
            fields.expect_u32("shared_expert_intermediate_size", self.shared_inter)?;
        }
        if fields.object.get("head_dim").is_some() {
            fields.expect_u32("head_dim", self.head_dim)?;
        } else {
            // The reference derives an absent head dimension from the hidden and head counts.
            let derived = hidden.checked_div(heads_q);
            fields.mismatch("head_dim", derived.map(u64::from), u64::from(self.head_dim))?;
        }
        let theta = fields.rope_theta()?;
        if theta != f64::from(self.rope_theta) {
            return Err(fields.differs("rope_theta", theta, self.rope_theta));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// The reference defaults differ by model type: `qwen3_5.py:51` sets `norm_topk_prob` true,
    /// and `qwen3_next.py:51` sets it false. The check therefore names the model type first.
    fn check_model_type(&self, root: &Value, fields: &Fields) -> Result<(), EngError> {
        if self.feed_forward.is_some() {
            fields.string("model_type")?;
        }
        let mut found = false;
        for level in [root, fields.object] {
            let Some(value) = level.get("model_type") else {
                continue;
            };
            found = true;
            let accepted = value
                .as_str()
                .is_some_and(|name| self.model_types.contains(&name));
            if !accepted {
                return Err(EngError::Checkpoint(format!(
                    "configuration model_type {value} is not one of {:?} for family {}",
                    self.model_types, self.name
                )));
            }
        }
        if found {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(EngError::Checkpoint(
                "configuration lacks model_type".into(),
            ))
        }
    }

    fn check_switches(&self, fields: &Fields) -> Result<(), EngError> {
        // The reference gates the attention output unconditionally (qwen3_next.py:123-158),
        // and the resolver expects the gate rows, so only an explicit false is wrong.
        if !fields.optional_bool("attn_output_gate")?.unwrap_or(true) {
            return Err(fields.differs("attn_output_gate", false, true));
        }
        for name in ["tie_word_embeddings", "attention_bias"] {
            if fields.optional_bool(name)?.unwrap_or(false) {
                return Err(EngError::Checkpoint(format!(
                    "configuration {name} is true, family {} loads untied embeddings and bias-free attention",
                    self.name
                )));
            }
        }
        let eps = fields.f64("rms_norm_eps")?;
        if eps as f32 != self.rms_norm_eps {
            return Err(fields.differs("rms_norm_eps", eps, self.rms_norm_eps));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn check_routing(&self, fields: &Fields) -> Result<(), EngError> {
        let act = match fields.string("hidden_act")? {
            "silu" => Act::Silu,
            "gelu_pytorch_tanh" | "gelu_new" | "gelu_fast" => Act::GeluApprox,
            other => {
                return Err(EngError::Checkpoint(format!(
                    "configuration hidden_act {other:?} is unsupported"
                )));
            }
        };
        if act != self.act {
            return Err(fields.differs(
                "hidden_act",
                format!("{act:?}"),
                format!("{:?}", self.act),
            ));
        }
        if self.feed_forward.is_some() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let Router::SoftmaxTopK { renorm } = self.router else {
            return Err(EngError::Checkpoint(format!(
                "family {} router {:?} has no configuration mapping",
                self.name, self.router
            )));
        };
        // The reference defaults an absent norm_topk_prob to true.
        let found = match fields.object.get("norm_topk_prob") {
            None => true,
            Some(Value::Bool(flag)) => *flag,
            Some(_) => {
                return Err(EngError::Checkpoint(
                    "configuration norm_topk_prob must be a boolean".into(),
                ));
            }
        };
        if found != renorm {
            return Err(fields.differs("norm_topk_prob", found, renorm));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
